<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="17" x2="315" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="17" x2="320" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="325" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="18" x2="345" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="356" y="9" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="358" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="2" fill="#15451F"/>
    <rect x="377" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="29,57 21,64 29,71" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="70" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Plan your trip</text>
    <text x="338" y="61" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">1 of 3</text>
    <rect x="24" y="84" width="342" height="6" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="24" y="84" width="114" height="6" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="132" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="24" y="158" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">Tell us about your trip so we can tailor</text>
    <text x="24" y="180" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">French lessons to your plans.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="211" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
    <rect x="23" y="220" width="344" height="58" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="22" y="219" width="344" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="38" y="235" width="28" height="20" rx="4" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
      <rect x="47.3" y="235" width="9.4" height="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="56.6" y="235" width="9.4" height="20" fill="#1899D6"/>
    </g>
    <text x="80" y="254" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Paris, France</text>
    <polyline points="338,242 344,248 350,242" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="24" y="298" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">We’ll use this to create useful travel lessons.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Dates -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="336" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">When are you going?</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="23" y="346" width="164" height="62" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
      <rect x="22" y="345" width="164" height="62" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="39" y="362" width="19" height="19" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="39" y1="368" x2="58" y2="368" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="44" y1="358" x2="44" y2="365" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="53" y1="358" x2="53" y2="365" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="70" y="376" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Jun 12, 2026</text>
      <text x="39" y="396" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">START DATE</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="202" y="346" width="164" height="62" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
      <rect x="201" y="345" width="165" height="62" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="218" y="362" width="19" height="19" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="218" y1="368" x2="237" y2="368" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="223" y1="358" x2="223" y2="365" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="232" y1="358" x2="232" y2="365" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="249" y="376" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Jun 18, 2026</text>
      <text x="218" y="396" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">END DATE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Activities section -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="443" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">What will you do there?</text>
    <text x="24" y="466" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose all that sound like your trip.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Activity cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="480" width="166" height="54" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="22" y="479" width="166" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="38" y="496" width="20" height="20" rx="5" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="42,506 47,511 55,501" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="70" y="512" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Order food</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="480" width="165" height="54" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="201" y="479" width="165" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="217" y="496" width="20" height="20" rx="5" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="221,506 226,511 234,501" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="249" y="512" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Meet locals</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="545" width="166" height="54" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="22" y="544" width="166" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="38" y="561" width="20" height="20" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9DAD88" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="577" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Go shopping</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="545" width="165" height="54" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="201" y="544" width="165" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="217" y="561" width="20" height="20" rx="5" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="221,571 226,576 234,566" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="249" y="577" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Sightsee</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Trip lesson message -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="616" width="344" height="67" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="22" y="615" width="344" height="67" rx="14" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="648" r="18" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="644" r="2" fill="#15451F"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="644" r="2" fill="#15451F"/>
    <polyline points="47,652 54,656 61,652" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="83" y="643" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your trip, your lessons</text>
    <text x="83" y="664" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">Practice phrases you’ll use in Paris.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="704" width="344" height="49" rx="13" fill="#15451F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="22" y="702" width="344" height="48" rx="13" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="194" y="733" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="331,721 337,726 331,731" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="780" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">You can change this later</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="796" x2="390" y2="796" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,813 48,806 57,813" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="812" width="12" height="11" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="48" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    <!-- Plan active -->
    <rect x="126" y="804" width="40" height="29" rx="8" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="137" y="811" width="18" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="141" y1="808" x2="141" y2="814" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="808" x2="151" y2="814" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="146" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Plan</text>
    <!-- Learn -->
    <circle cx="243" cy="817" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="243,809 245,815 251,815 246,819 248,825 243,821 238,825 240,819 235,815 241,815" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <text x="243" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Learn</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="337" cy="813" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="337" cy="826" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="337" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
